items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Kinderzuschlag decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar. Bei Versand mit der Post ist der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority (social-law letter, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 24.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this 4-day rule itself). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the one-month Widerspruch period starts running on 25.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 (Christmas Eve) is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in NW, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed. Final deadline: 24.12.2026 (to allow for post, send by about 18.12.2026).

items.title: Apply for Bildung und Teilhabe benefits at the local Kommune
items.quote: Mit dem Bescheid erhalten Sie Leistungen für Bildung und Teilhabe; den Antrag dafür stellen Sie bei Ihrer Kommune.
items.computation: The letter does not give any calendar date or period for filing this application with the Kommune; it only states that the person must apply there. No deadline can be computed from the text.

warnings: This letterhead is explicitly marked "Familienkasse (Musterausgabe)" and uses placeholder-style details (Familienkasse Musterlahn, Beispielwetzlar, an @arbeitsagentur.example e-mail address) — it reads as a sample/template document rather than a letter from a real, identifiable Familienkasse office; verify the sender's real name and address before relying on it.

The printed IBAN (DE76 5000 0000 0004 5901 00) does not pass the standard German IBAN checksum/length check, so it may be misprinted or a placeholder — in any case this benefit is paid TO you, so you should never need to send money to this IBAN; treat any request to pay money to it as suspicious.
No deadline is given for the separate Bildung-und-Teilhabe application at the Kommune, so its due date could not be determined; ask the Kommune directly.
